## ✨ What's new in v1.2.0

**Oaths are staked in SOL.** New Oaths take their stake in native SOL, quoted from the familiar ≈ $5, $10 and $25 choices. Misses, payouts, balances and claims show SOL; Bounties and older Oaths keep SKR. In **Try the demo** it works end to end. In **Use my wallet** (Devnet), starting a SOL Oath stays switched off and says so, until the matching backend and on-chain program are released and verified.

- **Friend invites recover.** If an invite link couldn't be created or looked up after staking, the invite screen restores or recreates it and offers a retry, without staking again.
- **Test SKR faucet:** eligibility is checked correctly.

**Fixes**

- Losses in SOL read correctly ("−0.057 SOL"). They used to show as "0.-57916664 SOL" on the claim screen, a broken Oath, finished Oaths, Rematch and results.
- The daily recap shows a day you missed as missed. It used to say "You kept · safe".
- Today no longer asks you to prove a Bounty you're already out of.
- A finished Oath stops saying "claim ready" once you've claimed it, and its final balances show the right unit.
- The "Verified · Day N" stamp keeps the time the day was kept.
- Release builds and secret scanning are hardened.
